fullPassage: Mental rehearsal is a technique used by professionals in all fields and can be beneficial for social workers to practice as well. Mental rehearsal is the skill of picturing oneself in a situation, without actually being there. E. Scott Geller notes that "the more vividly individuals can imagine themselves performing desired behaviors, the greater the beneficial impact of this technique on actual performance." It is wise for workers to utilize mental rehearsal to visualize themselves in undesirable situations. For example, a worker could picture herself being locked in a home with an angry client and how she would escape from that situation. By mentally taking oneself through that circumstance and imagining what one would do in that situation, the body and mind are more likely to respond favorably, rather than to freeze, if that situation were to ever occur. Consequently, the worker would be more prepared to respond to that unsafe scenario by having practiced the response during the mental rehearsal.

✅ ③ is the skill of picturing: 원문 일치 (be동사 + 명사 + of + 동명사)
✅ ④ could picture herself: 원문 일치 (조동사 could + 동사원형 + 재귀대명사)
det.tip: 명사 + by X에서 N이 X에 의해 행해지는 수동 관계 → N + 과거분사 + by X.

det.korean: ④ unfavorably(불리하게) → favorably(호의적으로/이롭게): 정신적 리허설 덕분에 신체와 정신이 '얼어붙기(freeze)'보다는 '호의적으로 반응할 가능성'이 높다는 맥락. unfavorably는 반의어로 바로 뒤의 'rather than to freeze' 대비 구조를 깨뜨려 부적절.

✅ ② vividly: 원문 일치 (원하는 행동을 '생생하게' 상상)
✅ ③ undesirable: 원문 일치 ('바람직하지 않은' 상황 시각화)
❌ ④ unfavorably → favorably (rather than to freeze의 대비 — 얼어붙는 것이 아닌 '호의적/긍정적' 반응)

det.korean: ② stay(머무르다) → escape(탈출하다): 화난 고객과 갇힌 위험 상황에서 복지사가 어떻게 '탈출할지' 상상하는 것이 정신적 리허설의 목적. stay로 바꾸면 '그 상황에 어떻게 머무를지 상상'이라는 비논리가 되어 정반대.
det.analysis:
✅ ① technique: 원문 일치 (정신적 리허설이라는 '기법')
❌ ② stay → escape (화난 고객 + 잠긴 집 = 위험 → 탈출 목적. stay는 논리 반대)
✅ ③ locked: 원문 일치 ('잠긴' 집 안에 갇힘)
✅ ④ prepared: 원문 일치 (리허설 덕분에 더 '준비된' 상태)
det.tip: 화난 고객 + 잠긴 집 → 탈출 시뮬레이션. stay는 리허설의 목적과 정반대.

questions.passage: Mental rehearsal is a technique used by professionals in all fields and can be beneficial for social workers to practice as well. Mental rehearsal is the skill of picturing oneself in a situation, without actually being there. E. Scott Geller notes that "the more vividly individuals can imagine themselves performing desired behaviors, the greater the beneficial impact of this technique on actual performance." It is wise for workers to utilize mental rehearsal to visualize themselves in undesirable situations. For example, a worker could picture herself being locked in a home with an angry client and how she would escape from that situation. By mentally taking oneself through that circumstance and imagining what one would do in that situation, the body and mind are more likely to respond favorably, rather than to freeze, if that situation were to ever occur. Consequently, the worker would be more prepared to respond to that unsafe scenario by having practiced the response during the mental rehearsal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 제목: 'Preparing for Crisis: The Power of Mental Rehearsal' — 위기 상황 대비와 정신적 리허설의 효능이라는 본문 핵심 두 축을 포착.
det.analysis:
✅ ① Preparing for Crisis + Power of Mental Rehearsal — 주제 정확 일치
❌ ② 법적 서류 처리: 본문에 없음
❌ ③ 상상의 한계: 본문은 상상의 효능을 강조 — 반대 프레임
❌ ④ Angry Clients Always Pose Threats: 화난 고객은 예시일 뿐, '항상 위협'은 과장
det.tip: crisis preparation + mental rehearsal = 본문의 기능 구조(대비 기법).

questions.passage: Mental rehearsal is a technique used by professionals in all fields and can be beneficial for social workers to practice as well. Mental rehearsal is the skill of picturing oneself in a situation, without actually being there. E. Scott Geller notes that "the more vividly individuals can imagine themselves performing desired behaviors, the greater the beneficial impact of this technique on actual performance." It is wise for workers to utilize mental rehearsal to visualize themselves in undesirable situations. For example, a worker could picture herself being locked in a home with an angry client and how she would escape from that situation. By mentally taking oneself through that circumstance and imagining what one would do in that situation, the body and mind are more likely to respond favorably, <u>rather than to freeze</u>, if that situation were to ever occur. Consequently, the worker would be more prepared to respond to that unsafe scenario by having practiced the response during the mental rehearsal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'rather than to freeze'의 freeze는 '얼어붙다/공포에 굳다'의 비유적 의미로, 위기 상황에서 몸과 마음이 마비되어 대응하지 못하는 상태를 가리킴. rehearsal 덕에 굳지 않고 호의적으로 반응한다는 대비.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 위기 상황 굳어 버림 — freeze의 공포 반응 비유 (fight/flight/freeze 중 freeze)
❌ ② 감정적 차가움: freeze의 '감정 냉담' 해석은 문맥과 다름 — 대응 마비가 주제
❌ ③ 신체적 추위: 물리적 해석은 rehearsal 맥락 무시
❌ ④ 대화 중단: 침묵 해석은 위기 대응 맥락에서 부분적일 뿐
det.tip: freeze in danger = 위기 앞에서 얼어붙다/마비되다. fight-flight-freeze의 세 번째 반응.

ch: 위기 상황에서 움직이지 못하고 굳어 버리는 대신이라는 것
